Dr German Gandelman is one of the most respected cardiologists in Israel, specialising in invasive cardiology. The term describes cardiac catheterisation, a procedure in which a range of surgical interventions on the heart are carried out by means of a narrow catheter passed through the blood vessels.

Using this technique Dr Gandelman is able to:

  • Widen narrowed coronary arteries;
  • Treat arrhythmias;
  • Implant artificial heart valves.

He also has deep expertise in diagnostic cardiac catheterisation, including coronary angiography, and in stenting.

Dr Gandelman also treats a range of conditions conservatively, such as the diabetic heart and heart failure. Patients from various countries can come to him for high-quality treatment using reliable Israeli medicines whose authenticity is guaranteed.

Every stenting and catheterisation procedure performed by Dr Gandelman meets the highest international standards. Thanks to his many years of experience in the field, every stage of the procedure has been honed to perfection. Russian viewers of the television programme «Zhit zdorovo!» had the opportunity to see Dr Gandelman's skill during this delicate operation.

Dr Gandelman is an active member of the Israel Medical Association and the Israel Heart Society.

MEMBERSHIP OF PROFESSIONAL SOCIETIES

Dr German Gandelman is a member of the Israel Medical Association, the country's largest professional body for doctors.

LANGUAGES

  • Hebrew
  • English

Urologist, reproductive specialist, andrologist, surgeon

Main areas of specialisation:

  • Inflammation of the urinary tract
  • Diseases of the bladder
  • Vesicoureteral reflux
  • Urethritis
  • Hydrocele
  • Hypospadias
  • Cystitis
  • Breaking up kidney stones
  • Diseases of the prostate
  • Benign prostatic hyperplasia
  • Prostatitis
  • Restoring erectile function

Summary:

Dr Gil Raviv is an excellent urologist, andrologist and surgeon, and an expert of international standing in the treatment of cancer of the prostate and bladder. He is a leading specialist in the urology department of a medical centre and director of the Institute of Sexual Medicine.

He is one of Israel's best specialists in transrectal ultrasound and transurethral endoscopy of the prostate. He has complete command of the surgical methods for treating varicocele and male infertility by the TESA and MESA techniques, for correcting structural abnormalities of the penis, and for treating impotence and cancers of the male reproductive organs.

Alongside his main clinical work, Gil Raviv takes an active part in international meetings with colleagues to exchange experience, and in symposia and scientific conferences.

Professor Raviv is also a teacher and senior lecturer in the department of urology in the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University. He has more than 65 publications, including work on experimental research in histology.

Additional specialisation:

  • Paediatric urology: laparoscopic pyeloplasty
  • Treatment of benign prostatic hyperplasia with the GreenLight laser
  • Brachytherapy
  • TVT-S procedure
  • Transurethral resection of the bladder
  • Obstruction of the urinary tract

Education:

  • Faculty of Medicine, Tel Aviv University
  • Fellowship in urethral surgery in Belgium
  • Fellowship in the treatment of male infertility and impotence at the Erasme University Hospital in Brussels

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English

Membership of international associations:

  • European Association of Urology
  • Israel Urological Association
  • European, American and Israeli societies of sexual medicine

Endocrinologist, dietitian
Main areas of specialisation:

  • The search for new treatment methods in clinical nutrition
  • Modern approaches to bariatric treatment
  • Treatment of diabetes
  • Treatment of cardiovascular disease
  • Management of pregnancy and the design of post-natal nutrition plans
  • Treatment of metabolic disorders
  • Treatment of obesity

Summary:

Dr Irena Zhitomirski is a highly experienced specialist of international standing in clinical nutrition. She is the leading dietitian at Assuta, Israel's largest clinic.

She is actively engaged in clinical work. Irena Zhitomirski points out that not every means of losing weight is a good one: certain basic rules need to be followed. She shares her knowledge, her observations and her many years of experience gladly with colleagues and patients, giving consultations and running seminars on healthy eating.

Dr Zhitomirski's professional interests include the search for new treatments for metabolic disorders, the care of cancer patients, and help with adjusting nutrition for pregnant women, women after childbirth and women going through the menopause. She also provides medical care to patients with learning disabilities who are treated in specialist institutions under the auspices of Israel's Ministry of Labour and Social Affairs.

Education:

  • Medical university in Saratov, Russia
  • Specialisation in clinical nutrition at the Hebrew University of Jerusalem, Israel
  • Advanced training in nutrition, gastrointestinal disease and bariatric medicine on specialist courses in Israel, the United States and Europe

Languages:

  • Hebrew
  • English
  • Russian

Endocrinologist
Experience: 35 years
Specialisation:
Dr Carlos Ben-Bassat is a highly qualified Israeli endocrinologist. At the Assuta clinic he treats patients with a range of disorders of the endocrine glands. He has a successful record in diagnosing and treating diabetes, under- and overactivity of the thyroid gland, and disorders of the pituitary. Dr Ben-Bassat carries out research into the treatment of malignant tumours of the thyroid gland.

  • Thyroid cancer
  • Gynaecomastia
  • Diabetes

Education and clinical experience:
2012
Head of the endocrinology department at the Assaf Harofeh clinic.
2006
After returning to Israel, began working as a senior physician in the endocrinology department of the Assuta medical centre.
1999
Took further specialisation in endocrinology at the University of Illinois at Chicago, USA.
1995
Completed a postgraduate residency in internal medicine at the Assuta medical centre and stayed on to work in its internal medicine department.
1989
Took his first medical degree in Spain, at the Complutense University of Madrid.

Academic and research work:
Dr Ben-Bassat is engaged in teaching: he runs a course in internal medicine in the faculty of medicine at Tel Aviv University.

Together with colleagues he carries out research. Some of the subjects of his papers are listed below:

  • Respiratory function in patients with diabetes;
  • Differentiated thyroid cancer in endocrinological practice;
  • Cushing's disease: long-term follow-up after transsphenoidal surgery.

Membership of medical associations:
Carlos Ben-Bassat is a member of:

  • The Endocrine Society, USA;
  • The Israel Endocrine Society;
  • The European Society of Endocrinology.

Plastic surgeon
Experience: more than 20 years

Specialisation:

Dr Liron Eldor is a highly qualified plastic and reconstructive surgeon. He specialises in breast reconstruction and augmentation, facial plastic surgery and microsurgery. Dr Eldor currently holds the post of director of the department of head and neck plastic and reconstructive surgery and of the Head and Neck Centre at the Rambam Medical Centre.

The main areas of his work include:

  • Breast reconstruction
  • Breast augmentation
  • Facial reconstruction
  • Blepharoplasty
  • Liposuction
  • Abdominoplasty
  • Aesthetic medicine

Education and clinical experience

  • Faculty of Medicine, Technion (Israel): degree in general medicine
  • Baylor University (USA): fellowship in plastic surgery
  • 2010 to the present: Director of the department of head and neck plastic and reconstructive surgery, Head and Neck Centre, Rambam Medical Centre
  • 2005-2010: Physician in the plastic surgery department, Rambam Medical Centre

Academic and research work

Dr Eldor is actively engaged in research, studying the genetic causes of breast cancer and the reinnervation of the breast after surgical treatment. He has many publications in international medical journals and speaks regularly at conferences on plastic and reconstructive surgery.

Procedures the doctor performs:

  • Liposuction of the abdomen, thighs, flanks, lower legs, knees, buttocks, back, neck, arms and chest (including Vaser liposuction)
  • Abdominoplasty
  • Blepharoplasty (eyelid correction)
  • Surgical breast reconstruction
  • Breast augmentation

Membership of international associations:

  • Israel Society of Plastic and Aesthetic Surgery
  • Israel Cancer Association

Dr Maor Lahav is a well-known Israeli gastroenterologist with more than 25 years of experience. This outstanding gastroenterologist heads the invasive endoscopy department at Assuta, Israel's largest clinic.

Dr Lahav is recognised internationally for his professionalism in gastroenterology and hepatology. He uses advanced methods of diagnosis and treatment, such as ESD, the technique of endoscopic submucosal dissection. This method allows the doctor to perform operations with minimal intervention and rapid recovery for the patient. Dr Lahav also uses the innovative method of radiofrequency ablation to treat Barrett's oesophagus, replacing the abnormal cells with healthy ones.

Maor Lahav is also known for his diagnostic skill, which allows him to detect cancers effectively at various stages of their development. He is known and respected not only in Israel but beyond it, and patients come to him from all over the world.

Alongside treating patients, Dr Lahav takes an active part in research, making a significant contribution to the development of medicine in his field. He presents regularly at international events and is the author of many research publications.

Dr Lahav speaks three languages fluently: Russian, English and Hebrew.

EDUCATION

  • Medical degree in the CIS
  • Sackler School of Medicine, Tel Aviv University, Israel
  • Fellowship in the treatment of gastroenterological conditions at the Sheba medical centre, Ramat Gan, Israel
  • Several years of fellowship at the University of Chicago hospital, USA

LANGUAGES

  • Russian
  • Hebrew
  • English

MEMBERSHIP OF INTERNATIONAL ASSOCIATIONS

  • Israel Gastroenterology Association
  • American Gastroenterological Association
